release_notes: `long_eod` exit: `hold_below_pts` skips the pre-expiry long-leg close when P&L is already worse than the expiry-guaranteed floor. Left at 0, a bracket long-combo (long call struck below a long put) auto-derives that floor from strikes/entry prices; any other leg shape just honors the DTE trigger as before. `long_eod` ctx now prices the long legs live instead of using the `0.0` `pnl_pts` default — needed for `hold_below_pts` (and any leg-scoped PT/SL) to evaluate correctly.
